Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::deleteLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		term: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		term.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->excludes(term) and
		result = true or
		term.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
